__comment: Authored at 8 voxels per block, 0.125 export scale baked into the GLB.
Stone rim is 1 block high; tallest flame is 2 blocks. Placement and collision cover 2x2x2.
RoomManager reads heat_source.heat_units. A multi-cell hearth contributes 400 units once, at its origin.
Named body/flame meshes preserve the stonework while ten voxel fire frames animate above the bowl.
Installed hearths emit warm, gently flickering light. Ghosts and packed items remain unlit.
The shared packed-furniture item and floor-placement behavior are unchanged.
description: A broad bowl of dressed stone with an iron grate, glowing coals and rising flames.
